title: ARTISANworks

services.name: Admission
services.desc: Public Hours Every Friday - Sunday, 12 to 5pm. Open 7 days for scheduled group tours and private events. ARTISANworks is fully accessible to visitors using wheelchairs, including all entrances, exhibits, and restrooms. Admission Adults $15, Seniors $10, Students $10, Children 5 & under FREE, Members

services.name: Tap Room
services.desc: Dedicated to the art of brewing, our Tap Room is full of nostalgic and bright items. This is a colorful and energizing space for business meetings and personal events and there is ample seating for dining and conducting business simultaneously. The space has private access for uninterrupted meetings and gatherings, customizable room settings, and may be used as a break-out room during large corporate conferences or paired with the Elizabeth Regional Gallery for additional guest capacity and accommodates up to 10
